fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head and ran it in a scratch repo with a plan workflow, using a rex stub that only logs window new: request ls says No plan requests; blank text and --kind chore exit 2 with usage errors; a feature, a bug and a milestone queue and show queued; --dry-run writes nothing. Paused, daemon --once starts nothing and opens no tab. Unpaused with --max-runs 1 it opens one tab for the oldest request: run start --workflow plan --new Add CSV exports --request <id> --permission-mode manual, not autonomous, and request ls shows planning with the run; a second --once with one slot starts nothing while that start is unjournaled. With rhiza.autonomy.plan auto and --max-runs 3 it starts the bug as --new Fix: Login fails on Safari ... --autonomous and the milestone with --milestone --autonomous. run start --request refuses an unknown request and needs --new. I could not run the plan run by hand, because run start refuses agent sessions, so the planned state with its change set comes from plan-requests.txtar passing (go test, -count=1) along with describe-golden.

Ran the built binary's rhiza tui app roadmap in a real Rex pane on a scratch repo and drove it with rex send-key: n, Export to CSV, enter shows a notice and queues a feature request; m, Ship v3, enter queues a milestone request (request ls shows both queued). n with text then esc, and n then an empty enter, queue nothing. The app opens no Rex window: the session's window list did not change apart from the app's own window.
